12.content: - Prioritize moves that reduce Manhattan distance to the goal (G), assigning higher values (e.g., 90+) to moves directly towards G and lower values (e.g., <50) to moves away from G.

14.content: - Penalize moves that lead into dead-ends or areas surrounded by hazards (H), rating them below 50 unless they are the only path to progress towards G.

15.content: - In situations where safe moves cause oscillation or no progress, slightly boost ratings (e.g., +10) for calculated risk moves that could advance towards G, even if adjacent to hazards.
